scope: Course input/runner only; old direct-drive release behavior and both physical side controllers unchanged.
initial_default_during_nine_case_matrix: release_abort; every tested matrix case explicitly selected commit_cycle_v1
post_matrix_changes: Ensure the reset control packet cannot falsely rearm even a generic direction-only headless adapter.
limitations: Only the fast flat-ground gait has passed these new-input physical gates.
Two explicitly cancelled cycles are retained as cancelled, not relabeled successful. Their final body positions need not equal the start.
One active cycle is interrupted by an explicit operator simulation reset, recorded as a separate segment, not a continuous physical transition.
No steering/braking/G1/jumping performance claim follows from this side-input validation.
